title: Carlos struggles to find the crash site in Moment of Contact

tellings.quote: And to me, if he were a liar, he would have said, "Here it is." But he gets there and he goes, "It wasn't here. In fact, the landscape has changed."

plain: In the 2022 documentary Moment of Contact, a man named Carlos de Souza, who says he came upon a crashed craft near the Brazilian town of Varginha, goes back to look for the spot and cannot find it, saying it was not there and that the landscape had changed. Michels tells this from the film, in which James Fox also appears. Michels takes it as a sign of honesty: a liar, he says, would simply have pointed and said "here it is."
